Coefficient (forest) plots

Source: R/plots.R
cr_plot_coef.Rd

Dot-and-whisker plot of the estimates in the results table: one row per term, outcomes in the package palette, a dashed line at no effect, a thick inner 90% CI and a thin outer CI at the table's level (the same interval the table reports), and the estimate with stars (or the p-value) above each point. Ratios (OR, IRR) use a log axis.

Usage

cr_plot_coef(
  x,
  dv = NULL,
  terms = NULL,
  contrasts = FALSE,
  inner = 0.9,
  p = c("stars", "value", "none"),
  show_values = TRUE,
  palette = NULL,
  style = "polsci",
  digits = 2
)

Arguments

x

A clean_results object.

dv

Outcomes to include (default: all).

terms

Variables to include (default: all but the intercept).

contrasts

Plot the pairwise contrasts instead of the coefficients.

inner

Level of the inner (thick) interval, or NULL for one interval. Not drawn for contrasts whose CIs are multiplicity-adjusted.

p

"stars", "value", or "none" for the point labels.

show_values

Print the estimate above each point.

palette

Palette name or colors.

style

Theme style (default "polsci", the forest style).

digits

Decimal places.

Value

A ggplot object.
